items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I just heard some records or something... I heard Sophie Tucker, and she was infamous.

ctx.x: Eddie Garland. Eddie Vincent on Trauma from Al J. Yeah. That was the first Dixley band left here with me Sophie Tucker on the circus, in the Arthur Theater, the Arthur Circus. That was years ago. He wasn't born. No, no. I just heard some records or something. Well there wasn't records made like them, there was cup records there. Yeah. With them cups. I heard Sophie Tucker, and she was infamous.
How did Freddie Kepard play? What style was he?
